title: Nonnegativity of total stable influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $0\\le\\rho\\le 1$. The total stable influence of $f$ at parameter $\\rho$ is nonnegative.
